answer: To determine if you are adequately hydrated, monitor your urine color. A pale yellow to clear color is generally indicative of proper hydration. Aim for at least 8 glasses (about 2 liters) of fluids daily, which can include water, herbal teas, and light beverages like coffee or sparkling water. Consistently having darker colored urine suggests you may need to increase your fluid intake. [ADA, 2015]
